name: Juvenile Warclaw
description: The warclaw has always been a very peculiar creature of study, previously thought to be Mists-locked and of an ethereal nature rather than biological. The warclaw of Janthir seem to be the origin of the creatures we know, possessing an untapped well of magic that manifests as immense speed and athletic ability. Occasionally, the feline will need to expel pent-up energies by running in a circle for minutes on end. —Acht
